rules.name: The Family Rule
rules.body: Tokens come from Cold Read. Job Apply changes only the accent.

rules.name: The Three Marks Rule
rules.body: ✓ green strong, ~ amber partial, ? grey gap. Nothing else uses those colours.

dos: Do copy new family tokens from Cold Read before inventing any.
Do keep sheets white in both themes.
Do give every claim in a demo a source line and label invented material as invented.
donts: Don't use em or en dashes in copy.
Don't add a second accent; FIX Red is the only one.
Don't use the mark colours for anything but the three marks and their verdict labels.
